summary: Central Puerto S.A. disclosed on Form 6-K that it and wholly owned subsidiary Proener S.A.U. acquired treasury shares under Argentina's Capital Markets Law No. 26,831, a US-equivalent open-market buyback. CPSA bought 120,000 ordinary shares on BYMA at an average AR$1,997.98, totaling AR$239,757,925; Proener bought 30,000 NYSE ADRs, representing 300,000 shares, at USD12.47, or USD374,319.02, both with trade completion 2026-10-06. Purchases stayed below 25% of the prior 90-business-day average daily trading volume. Watch share-cancellation or resale terms, ongoing program capacity, and ADR-ordinary arbitrage.
